Subject: SDE II comp signoff request — Daniel Park

Team — sending the comp package for Daniel Park (SDE II, West Coast). He finished onsite loop last week and flagged a verbal acceptance window of next Tuesday. TL;DR: request signoff on base/bonus/equity + one-time relocation stipend.

Summary (proposal attached):
- Base: $165,000
- Target bonus: 10% (annual)
- Equity: 0.25% (4-year, 1y cliff) — proposed grant: 2,500 RSUs (time-based schedule)
- Sign-on: $15,000 (relocation/one-time)
- Start window: Jan 4–18, 2027

Notes:
- Candidate is currently at a mid-stage startup; counterpressure expected on base.
- Comp band for SDE II shows midpoint $160k, max $170k (see comp sheet attached).

Attachments: offer_letter_danielpark_v1.pdf; comp-band-reference-Q4-2026.xlsx

Ask: please reply with APPROVE or REQUEST CHANGE by EOD Monday 11/30 so we can lock the offer and get DocuSign out. If you have edits to equity cadence or sign-on, call them out inline.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Hiring Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SDE II comp signoff request — Daniel Park

Monica — thanks for the concise summary. A few quick items:
1) Base at $165k is within band but on the higher side for the role in the Bay. I'm OK with it if the hiring manager certifies the strong loop feedback (please add the interview rubric avg).
2) Equity: 0.25% / 2,500 RSUs is fine, but let's change vesting schedule in the offer to 25% after 12 months, then quarterly thereafter (instead of monthly). Keeps our standard wording.
3) Sign-on: $15k seems high unless relocation is guaranteed. Can we make it $10k with an additional $5k contingent on 12-month retention? That reduces churn risk.

If Monica confirms the interview score and is comfortable with sign-on split, APPROVE from my side.

-karthik

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>

Karthik — thanks. Quick responses inline: 
- Interview rubric avg: 4.6/5 (attached snippet in Drive link). Strong on systems and product sense; one minor backend design gap.
- Agree to standard vesting cadence (25%/then quarterly). I'll update the offer language.
- Sign-on: happy to structure as you suggested ($10k up front + $5k retention after 12 months). Candidate indicated relocation is required.

Vivek/Laura — anything else? If no objections by EOD Monday, I'll update the DocuSign and send to candidate Tuesday morning.

Thanks,
Monica
